content: The United Homeless Organization is a charitable organization based in New York City, established in 1987. Its primary mission is to advocate for the homeless population and to collect monetary donations through tables set up at various locations across Manhattan. More than 75% of the individuals working for the organization are homeless, and all of them are either currently homeless or have experienced homelessness at some point in their lives. According to a 2001 article, at the donation tables, $15 per shift is allocated to the organization itself, while the remaining funds collected are retained by the individual soliciting the donations. This information was reported by Daniel B. Schneider in the New York Times (Late Edition, East Coast) on July 1, 2001, and accessed via ProQuest.
